$Comment: The skeleton every 'cull the local menace' quest in this pack shares. It is Abstract, so it is
never offered to anybody and needs no title, giver or reward of its own: it exists to be named
Retune the whole family here. Anything authored below reaches every member that did not state
its own value, so switching MatchMode to EXACT or lifting the hidden flag is a one-line change
CONTAINS on the kill step is what lets a member name a creature FAMILY (every Trork, every
Skeleton) rather than listing each variant. Author EXACT on a member that must count one
It sits in an unmarked folder, so its id is just the filename: the _-marked folders beside it
are the ones that push a prefix onto an id.
